requirement: Propagate MHC_KERNELS_ENABLED from the setuptools environment to CMake so the split FA2 binding can disable MHC while base glue retains its prebuilt MHC library.

upstream_evidence.finding: Both the frozen upstream base and fork tip omit MHC_KERNELS_ENABLED from cmake_build_ext.configure's _kernel_options list. The existing loop forwards only listed options; setup.py's separate additional_libraries check does not set a CMake cache variable. The fork has no setup.py delta.
MHC_KERNELS_ENABLED defaults to ON. Its true branch adds csrc/xpu/mhc/xe_2 and defines VLLM_MHC_ENABLED. An OFF environment variable alone does not override CMake option defaults.

Nix maps featureOptions booleans to ON/OFF environment values. Base glue selects MHC=true and imports the MHC library. FA2 binding selects MHC=false and withMhcLibrary=false. Its source projection in nix/lib/kernel-glue-src.nix excludes the MHC directory, so allowing the CMake default ON violates that projection and tries to configure an absent subtree.
The separately investigated, unselected v0.1.17 also omits this option. Its setup.py changes do not provide an upstream replacement.

minimal_residual: Retain the existing one-line addition to _kernel_options unchanged. It uses upstream's existing _is_enabled normalization and forwarding loop; no separate environment parser or CMake workaround is needed.
dependencies: The Nix split-glue factory and source projection require FA2's MHC disablement.
Patch0001 supplies imported MHC targets when base glue enables the feature; patch0006 independently ensures the disabled FA2 component does not enter that target branch.
No vLLM runtime ABI or serving option changes are introduced.
